sentence: This project studies how adult human stem cells transform into the cells in cartilage.
This project studies how AI systems can better coordinate with humans by adapting to changing human readiness under time pressure.
This project develops security-related courses and research activities that build cybersecurity education and research capabilities.
This project builds research tools and methods to study glycans, which are complex carbohydrates found in all living organisms.
This project designs, creates and characterizes superconducting qubits made entirely from two-dimensional materials.
This project studies how a genetic variant in a protein that allows cells to feel mechanical forces changes their response to traumatic brain injury.
This project studies how institutions that manage surface water and groundwater make decisions that depend on each other.
This project develops algorithms to manage the uncertainties of renewable generation so electric power systems run reliably at least cost.
This project tests whether citrates, often derived from lemon juice, combined with inorganic salts can dissolve mineral scale made of calcite.
This project builds a laboratory to measure devices, circuits and materials at high radio frequencies.
This project develops workshops that introduce commonly used micro-/nanofabrication techniques such as microscopy and photolithography.
This project studies what children need from their prostheses and builds custom 3D-printed prostheses for them.
This project builds custom hardware accelerators that analyze genome sequencing data.
This project studies how beavers moving into arctic tundra change the landscape, permafrost and streams, using satellite images and fieldwork.
This project develops voltage-controlled superconducting logic that works at cryogenic temperatures.
This project develops modules and a synthetic-data-based range about cybersecurity risks in healthcare systems that use AI.
This project builds a system that uses AI agents and system logs to reconstruct cyber attacks on scientific institutions.
